title: Mermaid Diagram Standard
idiom: Rackham ink and watercolour, a mermaid laying out a graph of shells and kelp
hero_prompt: Ink and watercolour illustration in the manner of Arthur Rackham, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible ink line and watercolour texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a mermaid seated on a low rock at the shore, laying out round seashells on the flat wet sand and joining them with strands of green kelp into a branching network of nodes and links, small waves curling behind her. Soft sea greens, sand, coral and muted blue.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a sea-green ground, no shading or gradients: a curling mermaid's tail beside three round shells joined by two straight lines. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
